name: GitHub Copilot SDK — direct to APIM
summary: Copilot SDK BYOK provider pointed straight at the APIM AI Gateway, bypassing Foundry entirely.
description: APIM already exposes an OpenAI-compatible surface, so `base_url = "https://<apim>.azure-api.net/openai/v1/"` + APIM subscription key (or a static JWT via `bearerToken`) lets the Copilot SDK talk to your AI Gateway without any Foundry involvement. In this topology there is no `{conn}/{model}` BYOM prefix — the model string is just the APIM deployment name, because you're already at the gateway.
notes:
Not yet verified end-to-end. The test `test.py` builds a Copilot session against `APIM_BASE_URL` (subscription key or bearer token) and sends a single message — run it locally to confirm. No BYOM prefix here: APIM is already the gateway, so `wire_model` is just the deployment name at APIM.

Use this path when you want APIM's load-balancing, rate-limiting, or observability without Foundry orchestration.

**Auth:** subscription key via `Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key` header, or a bearer token if the gateway is Entra-fronted. For Entra, prefer `bearer_token_provider` (callable, refreshes per request) over the static `bearer_token` field.
